proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Adoption of Improved Shareholder Right to Call a Special Shareholder Meeting
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend governing documents so owners of a combined 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Adoption of a Policy to Cease Financing New Fossil Fuel Development
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a time-bound phase-out of lending and underwriting to companies engaged in new fossil fuel exploration and development.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
